wiki.title: Barry Crago
wiki.extract: Barry Crago is an American attorney, rancher, and politician serving as a Republican member of the Wyoming Senate, representing District 22 since 2025. He previously served as a member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 40 from 2021 to 2024.
